notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only page that names the tower gives a 1954 survey description (four-legged steel, about 110 feet, observation cabin), the Ozark National Forest agency and the word Removed. No build date, removal date, staffing, notable events or access source was found; two web searches and the Central US Lookouts and Encyclopedia of Arkansas pages gave nothing more. The 110 feet is the survey's figure and does not say whether it runs to the cab floor, so height_m (33.5) is the record's figure. The NGS coordinates (35 29 43 / 092 53 51) match the record within about 0.0001 degree. The NGS listing has a second row for this mark coded NN; the story uses the XX row. The Encyclopedia passage is statewide context only and says nothing about Peterman. Verify the removal and its date with the Ozark National Forest before publishing.
